name: Vay
what: Teledriven (remote-driven) electric car rental and delivery service.
homonym_note: Same company as the creandum, atomico and coatue rows (Vay Technology GmbH, formerly Ree Technology GmbH).

membership.basis: Live visionaries.vc portfolio; Vay's own Series B release names Visionaries Club; Growth Fund I lists a 2024 shareholding in Vay Technology GmbH.
membership.quote: Project A, Visionaries Club and signals Venture Capital participated in the round

entry.quote: Project A, Visionaries Club and signals Venture Capital participated in the round

funding_rounds.source: https://vay.io/press-release/vay-raises-95m-series-b-round-becomes-highest-funded-startup-in-europe-to-pursue-self-driving-car-technology/ (Atomico led the Series A; amount per the atomico row's Deutsche Startups citation)

funding_rounds.round: Strategic investment (Grab): USD 60M upfront, up to USD 350M more on milestones

notes: Vay's release separates 'existing investors Atomico, La Famiglia, and Creandum' from Project A, Visionaries Club and signals, so Visionaries is new in the B. Register: Visionaries Club Growth Fund I lists a 2024 shareholder-list mention of Vay Technology GmbH (https://www.northdata.com/Visionaries%20Club%20Growth%20Fund%20I%20GmbH%20&%20Co%C2%B7%20KG,%20Berlin/Amtsgericht%20Charlottenburg%20(Berlin)%20HRA%2055965%20B). No valuation disclosed for the Series B or the Grab deal. Tech Funding News (2025-11) says Vay is 'currently based in Las Vegas' for US operations; the company remains a Berlin GmbH, siblings carry Berlin.
